disclaimer: Indicative reference data, not tax advice. 2026/27 to 2029/30 are the ITEPA 2003 s139 tables as set by Finance Act 2023 and Finance Act 2025; 2030/31 is as announced at Budget 2026 (28 October 2026), to be legislated in Finance Bill 2026-27. eVED per Autumn Budget 2025. Verify against HMRC guidance before relying on these figures.
description: Company car tax appropriate percentages by fuel type and tax year. The percentage is applied to the vehicle P11D value to give the taxable benefit.

taxYears.source: Budget 2026 (28 Oct 2026), to be legislated in Finance Bill 2026-27

zeroEmission.description: Battery electric vehicles. Selected by fuel type, never by CO2 = 0, so a zero-CO2 PHEV does not fall into this schedule.

plugInHybrid.description: 1 to 50 g/km. Banded by electric-only range to 2027/28, then a single rate for all 1-50 g/km vehicles.

internalCombustion.description: 51 g/km and above, petrol and diesel: the s139 table for each tax year (see co2-bands.json), capped at that year's maximum.

dieselSurcharge.appliesTo: Diesel vehicles not certified to RDE2
dieselSurcharge.note: Added to the year's percentage, then capped at that year's maximum (ITEPA 2003 s141).
